dispositions.topic_text: Which exact parent or service folders each write is permitted to create
dispositions.what: delivery_store note (State 7): each write creates only the folders of its own address; no other service folder is created ahead of use.

dispositions.topic_text: Which crash classes the atomic-write guarantees cover and what directory durability is required
dispositions.what: delivery_store note (State 7): a crash is an end of the process or host before the write returns; durability of the image is synchronising the file, each folder created for it in its parent and its own folder.
